title: Mozilla revamps security after AI successfully exploits 6 Firefox releases
description: A widely available open-weight AI model can turn unshipped Firefox security fixes into working exploits before most users receive the update. This information was derived from research conducted by Epoch AI. The model, GLM 5.3, is from the Chinese lab Z.ai. It has successfully compromised 6 recent Firefox releases between mid-September and late October.
